body:
10:00 PM - Checked my Hydro stash. 4x 7.5's left. Figure I'd take 15mg then a 7.5mg supplement for a chill night. Downed 15mg.
11:00 PM - Barely ate anything all day so it should have kicked in by now. Feeling nothing at all. Ate that 7.5mg supplement.
11:45 PM - Barely feeling a buzz. Maybe I built up a tolerance? Wouldn't make sense though considering the last time. I've done opiates was over a month ago. Pretty much just said 'Fuck it' and downed the last pill in my stash. bringing me to 30mg total dosage.
12:15 AM - Starting to feel some nausea. Effects are certainly building up. Playing some guitar to keep my mind off the nausea. Not working too well.
12:25 AM - Nausea's pretty much gone. Listening to some music now. Feel a small buzz creeping up on me. Sure would suck if those four pills went to waste.
12:45 AM - Feeling fucking amazing. Not much emotional euphoria like I've had previous times, but the physical euphoria, my god it's awesome, a warm blanket of love sweeping over my body, everywhere, through my veins, euphoria.
2:15 AM - Just puked. Drank a lot of water beforehand so it wasn't  too bad. Puking with the Doors' 'Touch Me' playing while completely engulfed in euphoria is quite an interesting experience. Let's throw away the puke and crash. Good, good, good, GOOD night. Sucks I'm out of Hydro now, but that's probably for the best.
